title: The three AI architect roles that pay $200k
oneliner: Enterprise AI Architect (strategy + governance + business alignment), AI Solution Architect (end-to-end AI systems), Cloud AI Architect (cloud-native AI services and deployment).
says: Three AI architect roles pay around $200k. The Enterprise AI Architect designs enterprise AI strategy, owns AI governance, and aligns AI with the business. The AI Solution Architect designs AI systems end to end and solves AI-related problems. The Cloud AI Architect knows the AI services running in the cloud and builds and deploys cloud-native AI applications.
explained: The trio maps neatly onto the career material elsewhere in this archive. The enterprise role is wide: strategy, governance, business alignment - the evolution of the enterprise architect from reel #6. The solution role is deep: one system, end to end - the evolution of the classic solution architect. The cloud role is platform-specific: the AI services of one cloud, done properly - the 'non-negotiable skills' reel made into a job title.

Use the list as a positioning tool. The three roles share a vocabulary but hire for different evidence: the enterprise role wants governance and stakeholder stories; the solution role wants a system you can whiteboard; the cloud role wants provider-specific depth. Apply with the matching portfolio emphasis - the same GitHub repo can be framed three ways.
takeaway: Same field, three doors: strategy (enterprise), systems (solution), platform (cloud). Aim your portfolio at the one you want.
